name: antigravity-booster
description: Parallel multi-agent fleet orchestrator for Google Antigravity: compiles specs into ticket DAGs, dispatches isolated git-worktree builders across Gemini and Claude/GPT quota pools, and enforces ADLC frozen rails and cross-model diff prosecution.
suggestedPrompts: Run /agb-shape to interview me on a new feature concept, validate the ticket DAG, and run the 5-lens Plan ARL.
Run /agb --yolo to autonomously shape, compile, execute, and review a feature end-to-end across Gemini and Claude quota pools.
Run /code-review on my current branch to audit the diff across Correctness, Security, Simplicity, Evidence, and Anti-Slop.
author: Chris Williams
